Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter open-weight multimodal model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, distilled from Muse Spark for always-on local agents, tool use, coding, and image understanding.
Muse Spark is a natively multimodal reasoning model with support for tool-use, visual chain of thought, and multi-agent orchestration.
Muse Spark 1.2 is a coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1 with improvements in code generation, complex debugging, codebase understanding, and end-to-end developer workflows.

Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta for long-running agentic, multi-agent, and coding workflows. It improves long-horizon agent collaboration, instruction following, and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.
Muse Spark Open is an 816B total / 42B active open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Meta for coding and long-horizon agentic work, with 1M-token context.

Muse Wonder is a frontier multimodal reasoning model from Meta for personal and professional agents, long-horizon coding, and computer use. It combines Active Memory, which carries relevant context across conversations, with Active Focus, which keeps it working through blockers toward a goal.

Muse Wonder Full is the most capable model in Meta's Muse Wonder series, built for long-running professional agents and ultra-long-horizon software engineering. It shares Muse Wonder's Active Memory and Active Focus capabilities and generally scores higher on Meta's agentic and coding evaluations.

GLM-Image is an image generation model adopts a hybrid autoregressive + diffusion decoder architecture. In general image generation quality, GLM‑Image aligns with mainstream latent diffusion approaches, but it shows significant advantages in text-rendering and knowledge‑intensive generation scenarios. It performs especially well in tasks requiring precise semantic understanding and complex information expression, while maintaining strong capabilities in high‑fidelity and fine‑grained detail generation. In addition to text‑to‑image generation, GLM‑Image also supports a rich set of image‑to‑image tasks including image editing, style transfer, identity‑preserving generation, and multi‑subject consistency.
